hooks.name: Related tests on save
hooks.description: Runs the vitest tests related to a saved src/**/*.ts file (scripts/hooks/related-tests.sh).

hooks.name: Related tests on save (Kiro Web, PostToolUse)
hooks.description: Runs the vitest tests related to a saved src/**/*.ts file (scripts/hooks/related-tests.sh). Twin for Kiro Web, which has no File Save trigger.

action.command: CRYPT_HOOK_TRIGGER=PostToolUse CRYPT_HOOK_FILTER='(^|/)src/.*\.ts$' bash scripts/hooks/run-logged.sh related-tests-on-save scripts/hooks/related-tests.sh
